title: Advancing Harmful Content Detection in Organizational Research: Integrating Large Language Models with Elo Rating System
measurement_description: The paper evaluates the performance of an Elo rating-based Large Language Model method for detecting harmful content, specifically measuring the detection of hate speech which includes religious-based hate speech as one of its categories.
base_benchmarks: Davidson et al. (2017) Hate Speech Dataset
findings: The proposed Elo rating-based method using GPT-4o-mini significantly outperformed traditional machine learning models and standard zero-shot LLM prompting in detecting hate speech (which included religious hate speech), achieving higher accuracy, precision, and recall.
